model_name: BTC/USDT market regime detector — Gaussian Hidden Markov Model
selection_method: Fit K=2..5 (then K=2..7 in an extended check), each with 20 random EM restarts. Selected by lowest BIC among restarts that pass a health check (rejects degenerate fits: non-finite parameters, invalid transition-matrix rows, or any state occupying <1% of frames). Cross-checked against state economic interpretability (persistence, distinctness) before locking in.

definitions.feat_logret: 3-day rolling mean of 1-day log return (close-to-close), on daily bars
definitions.feat_vol: 14-day rolling std of 1-day log returns, on daily bars
definitions.feat_adx: 14-period ADX computed on daily bars (via the `ta` library), a directionless trend-strength measure

features.why_these_three: Return+vol alone (the classic 2-feature regime setup) could not separate 'chop' from 'calm trending' -- both look identical on those two dimensions. ADX was tested against an autocorrelation-based alternative and won: ADX cleanly separated trend strength (tight per-state std relative to inter-state gaps) while autocorrelation only added noise and shortened state persistence.

data.source: Binance public REST API, BTC/USDT daily spot OHLCV
data.coverage: 2017-08-17 -> 2026-07-22 (3,262 raw daily bars, 3,248 after feature warmup)

decoding_method.live_safe_method: filtered (causal forward algorithm, hand-implemented) -- uses only data up to and including time t, no future information
decoding_method.historical_only_method: smoothed (forward-backward, hmmlearn predict_proba) -- uses the WHOLE sequence including future bars; valid ONLY for historical interpretation, NEVER for live signals (this would be lookahead bias, the HMM-equivalent of the entry-price/next-bar-ATR bugs already fixed elsewhere in this codebase)
decoding_method.agreement_rate: ~98% on synthetic validation data; disagreements cluster at regime-change boundaries, exactly where the distinction matters most

deployment.mapping_to_1h: daily regime forward-filled onto hourly bars with a 1-DAY LAG: a day's regime is only 'available' starting the following day 00:00, since it isn't known until that daily bar has actually closed -- no lookahead
deployment.mapping_script: fetch_1h_and_map_regime.py (not included in this package -- ask if needed; the already-mapped output is included as decoded_daily_regime_states.csv plus the daily OHLCV here for full reproducibility of the fit itself)

files.training_data_daily_ohlcv: btc_daily_ohlcv_reconstructed.csv (resampled from the continuous 1H series to daily bars -- 3,262 rows, matches the original fetch exactly)
files.decoded_output: decoded_daily_regime_states.csv (per-day features + filtered/smoothed state assignments and probabilities)
